'''Aphiram Clay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Clay was a major supporter of the [[Novinyet Biochemical Corporation]] despite evidence of shady dealings on their part; investigation uncovered that he had taken several bribes from the company, and he was forced to step down as a result.<ref name="Mission" />
